title: Tungkhungia Buranji Or A History Of Assam (1681-1826 A.D.)
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan
description: Standard scholarly edition of the official Tungkhungia dynasty chronicle translated from Assamese and Tai manuscript registers. Details royal succession, diplomatic protocols with Burma, and territorial governance under the later Tai Ahom rulers.
